shots.action: A locked-off camera holds on the dark window of a night bus, rain sheeting across the glass in wavering vertical trails. Beyond the pane the city is a soft smear of amber streetlamps and red taillights, while inside the bus the empty seat backs and grab rails sit in deep, dim shadow. Droplets already cling to the glass and a few break free and slide, dragging thin bright lines through the reflected light.
